status: Active Common20 execution admission for initialized instances and single-source-call-v1 GPU leases
invariants: CommonInstance.admit validates magic, wire version 20, capability 1020, SHA-256 schema hash, payload integrity, target, inputIdentity, scopeDigest, and publishedDigest before creating an instance.
Module initialization executes once in dependency order and persists initialized global slots across subsequent requests.
At most one exclusive GPU/Host lease may be active per CommonInstance; writeback validates all writable targets atomically before committing any slot.
Traps and device failures perform zero global writes and preserve original diagnostic codes, rule identities, source anchors, and post-failure budgets.
